claim_verdicts.evidence: perf/best-practices.md: 'localize the setState() call to the part of the subtree whose UI actually needs to change. Avoid calling setState() high up in the tree if the change is contained to a small part of the tree.' setState doc: 'The _indirect_ cost ... is high: it causes the widget to rebuild, possibly triggering rebuilds for the entire subtree rooted at this widget'. Supports 'rebuilding only the subtree keeps a small change cheap'.

State.setState doc: 'The provided callback is immediately called synchronously. It must not return a future (the callback cannot be `async`)'. Body: 'final Object? result = fn() as dynamic; assert(() { if (result is Future) { throw FlutterError.fromParts([ErrorSummary('setState() callback argument returned a Future.') ...' then '_element!.markNeedsBuild();'. An assert runs only in debug. A Dart arrow body returns its expression's value (the assigned Future); a block body without return yields null. Stage-1 block body: exc=null in test.
